evals.name: stage-routing-setup
evals.prompt: I want to set up akuko for my project and configure our budget cap and keys. Project state: no budget cap is recorded.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/setup.md. Conducts the setup interview: provider keys (reports set/not set without printing secrets), budget cap (required number in provider currency), defaults (aspect ratio, target runtime), and brand settings. Writes budget cap and settings to akuko.json.
assertions: Routes to actions/setup.md
Conducts the setup interview covering provider keys and budget cap
Refuses to complete setup without an explicit budget cap number
Writes akuko.json.budget atomically through the host adapter

evals.name: stage-routing-doctor
evals.prompt: Check my setup to see what's missing in my film environment. Project state: project exists in ./my-film with budget cap set.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/doctor.md. Runs doctor diagnostics for Node version, media toolchains (FFmpeg, HyperFrames, Chrome), provider API keys presence, and budget cap integrity. Reports health status in plain language without revealing key values.
assertions: Routes to actions/doctor.md
Checks Node version and optional media toolchains
Reports provider keys presence without exposing secret values
Reports diagnostic exit code and advice without modifying files unasked

evals.name: stage-routing-intake
evals.prompt: Start a film project from this short story text and bring it in. Project state: no project exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/intake.md. Detects host, detects source kind as prose, asks the user whether to adapt to a Fountain screenplay first (adapt) or break down directly (direct). Upon choice, records script/source.md (and script/screenplay.fountain if adapt) at pending-review and pauses at the review gate.
assertions: Routes to actions/intake.md
Detects host and creates new project through host adapter
Asks whether to adapt to a screenplay first or break down directly
Records script assets at pending-review and stops at intake review gate

evals.name: stage-routing-breakdown
evals.prompt: Break down the screenplay into scenes and shots. Project state: intake is approved by a person; shots and scenes are currently empty.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/breakdown.md. Verifies intake is approved. Analyzes screenplay into scenes, beats, shot list (each shot ≤ 10 s, ≤ 2 principals in frame), and bible checklist. Applies proposal via applyBreakdown, runs tag and lint, sets units to pending-review, and stops at breakdown review gate.
assertions: Routes to actions/breakdown.md
Verifies intake is approved before opening breakdown
Enforces shot constraints: duration <= 10 s and at most 2 principal characters
Applies proposal, tags screenplay, lints without errors, and stops at review gate

evals.name: stage-routing-board
evals.prompt: Draw the sketch board for the film. Project state: breakdown stage is approved by a person.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/board.md. Verifies breakdown is approved. Evaluates shot blocking, draws deterministic SVG framing-diagram panels on a thirds grid with move arrows, writes 9-panel beat boards, sets shots to pending-review at stage sketch, and pauses for review.
assertions: Routes to actions/board.md
Verifies breakdown is approved before opening sketch
Generates SVG framing panels without inventing blocking not present in text
Stores panels, updates shots to pending-review at stage sketch, and pauses at review gate

evals.name: stage-routing-bible
evals.prompt: Build the character and location bibles. Project state: intake, breakdown, and sketch board are all approved.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/bible.md. Plans visual bible assets (lookbook first, then character portraits and plates, then turnarounds). Presents spend quote through the spend gate and waits for human approval before generating any paid images.
assertions: Routes to actions/bible.md
Enforces bible order: lookbook first, then portraits/plates, then turnarounds
Routes paid generation through the spend gate with estimate and confirmation line
Audits sheets and moves created assets to pending-review for board review

evals.name: stage-routing-keyframes
evals.prompt: Render the keyframes for shot 1. Project state: intake, breakdown, sketch and bible are all approved; the bible turnarounds and plates are approved with files; a budget cap is set; the keyframes stage is not started.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/keyframes.md. Folds decisions first, plans one key frame per shot, and builds the prompt from the approved turnarounds, plates and lookbook (the sketch composition goes in as text, not as an SVG). With a paid provider it prints the spend line and waits for approval before anything is sent; nothing is generated until the person approves. The finished frame is audited, recorded as pending-review, and the run stops at the review gate. It never writes approved.
assertions: Routes to actions/keyframes.md
Folds decisions first and plans one key frame per shot
Takes references from the approved turnarounds and plates, with sketch composition as text only
Prints the spend line and waits for approval before any paid generation
Audits the frame, marks it pending-review and stops at the review gate without approving it

evals.name: stage-routing-view
evals.prompt: Show me the review board for the film. Project state: sketch stage is in-review.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/view.md. Detects host, folds decisions first, and provides the default board view or designs a conforming view meeting the view contract.
assertions: Routes to actions/view.md
Folds decisions before rendering view so current state is displayed
Presents the conforming default board for review

evals.name: stage-routing-status
evals.prompt: Where are we with the project and what's next? Project state: project exists in ./my-film.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/status.md. Read-only: detects host, reads state, derives pending reviews, pending spend approvals, current stage, budget summary, and suggests the next action without modifying files.
assertions: Routes to actions/status.md
Performs read-only inspection without folding or writing akuko.json
Reports pending units, spend status, and current stage accurately
Recommends the appropriate next action

evals.name: stage-routing-review
evals.prompt: I reviewed the board and left comments and approvals. Apply my notes. Project state: decisions.jsonl has new decisions recorded from a conformed view.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/review.md. Reads decisions from host store, validates provenance, folds decisions with foldDecisions(), updates unit statuses, and writes state atomically with a fold report.
assertions: Routes to actions/review.md
Reads decisions from the host store
Validates decision provenance against conformed view list
Applies status transitions and reports changes and rejections

evals.name: gating-keyframes-before-bible-approved
evals.prompt: Render the key frames for scene 1 now. Project state: breakdown and sketch board are approved, but the bible stage is still in-review with character portraits pending review.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/keyframes.md. The keyframes stage is locked because it opens only when intake, breakdown, sketch and bible are all approved. Refuses to plan or generate anything, names the bible stage as the one still waiting for a person's approval, points to the review board, and leaves akuko.json and every stage state unchanged.
assertions: Routes to actions/keyframes.md
Refuses because the key-frame stage is locked until intake, breakdown, sketch and bible are approved
Names the bible stage as the one that is waiting for approval
Makes no paid call and creates no key-frame assets
Leaves project state and stage locks unchanged

evals.name: spend-gate-no-budget-refusal
evals.prompt: Generate the character bible portraits using Gemini image provider. Project state: akuko.json.budget is null (no budget cap set).
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/bible.md, which sends the paid generation through the spend gate. The gate checks the budget cap, sees budget is null, refuses the paid job with the no-budget code, prints the setup pointer, and directs the user to /akuko setup to record a budget cap.
assertions: Routes to actions/bible.md
Refuses paid provider execution when budget cap is null
Emits the SETUP_POINTER refusal message
Directs user to /akuko setup to configure budget cap
Makes zero paid provider API calls

evals.name: breakdown-rerun-idempotency
evals.prompt: Run breakdown again on the screenplay. Project state: scenes and shots are already populated (shots[] has 12 shots).
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/breakdown.md. Recognizes shots[] is not empty, enters TAG ONLY branch, creates/deletes/reorders zero shots or scenes, only runs retag and lint, and leaves akuko.json untouched.
assertions: Detects that scenes or shots already exist (alreadyBrokenDown)
Refuses to create new shots or duplicate breakdown units
Runs tag and lint only, preserving existing shot IDs and akuko.json
Reports that zero units were created

evals.name: stage-routing-motion
evals.prompt: Make the clips for scene 1. Project state: intake, breakdown, sketch, bible and keyframes are all approved; a budget cap is set and FAL_KEY is in the environment; the motion stage is not started.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/motion.md. Folds decisions first, plans one clip per shot, and makes them one shot at a time. With the paid provider it prints the spend line with the arithmetic and waits for approval before anything is sent. Says how the clip length covers the shot and that sound is off, audits each clip, marks it pending-review and stops at the review gate without approving it.
assertions: Routes to actions/motion.md
Makes one clip per shot, one shot at a time, from the shot's approved key frame
Prints the spend line (the price per second times the length) and waits for approval before any paid call
Stops at the 3-paid-attempt limit per shot, and raises it only when the person asks for more tries in their own words
Uses the default clip length that covers the shot, and takes --fit nearest only when the person asks to spend less
Marks the clip pending-review and stops at the review gate without approving it

evals.name: stage-routing-sound
evals.prompt: Add the voice-over for the film. Project state: intake, breakdown, sketch, bible and keyframes are approved; shot 1 has narration text set by the person; shots 2 and 3 have only a script line; a budget cap is set and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is in the environment.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/sound.md. Folds decisions first and plans a voice-over only for the shot that has narration. Shows the person the script lines of the other shots and asks which to voice; it never writes narration text itself. A paid take needs a voice id from the person, a spend line and approval. Takes go to pending-review and the stage stops at the review gate.
assertions: Routes to actions/sound.md
Never invents narration text: only the shot's narration is voiced as it stands
Plans script lines as voice-over only after the person says, in their own words, which shots (script-lines confirmation)
Requires --voice from the person and picks no default voice
Prints the spend line and waits for approval before any paid call
Marks each take pending-review and stops at the review gate without approving it

evals.name: stage-routing-export
evals.prompt: Export the film to DaVinci Resolve. Project state: key frames and sound are approved; some clips are approved, some are still pending review.
evals.expected_output: Routes to actions/export.md. Folds decisions first, asks for the frame rate, and runs the handoff to write a FCPXML timeline (EDL as fallback) with the media. Uses only approved material and lists everything else in the left-out list with its status. Moves no status and writes nothing to akuko.json. Does not claim it imported into Resolve.
assertions: Routes to actions/export.md
Folds decisions first and asks for the frame rate if the person has not said
Uses approved material only and reads out every item in the left-out list
Writes a FCPXML timeline for Resolve (EDL only as the fallback)
Moves no unit or stage status and writes nothing to akuko.json
Does not say the timeline imported into Resolve, and does not offer an MP4 render

evals.name: stub-action-assemble-refusal
evals.prompt: Assemble the animatic and the rough cut. Project state: sound and motion are approved.
evals.expected_output: Stub ask (the rough cut and picture lock are not built yet). Routes to actions/assemble.md. Reads the action doc, sees that the rough cut and picture lock are marked 'Stub (WP-02)', tells the user they are not built yet, offers the free assemble preview (an animatic from the approved key frames that is never a review unit and is not saved to the project) and /akuko status, and does not improvise a rough cut.
assertions: Routes to actions/assemble.md
Identifies that the rough cut and picture lock are a stub that is not built yet
Stops without attempting to improvise or fabricate a rough cut or picture lock
Offers the free assemble preview for the animatic, and says it is not a review unit and is not saved to the project
Offers /akuko status as next step
